title: Deployment story: one box to many runner hosts
summary: Operator and administrator journeys through one-box Docker, added runner hosts and remote authority, with current-source availability, option C reconciliation, recommended decisions and promotion-ready implementation slices.

implementationTasks.title: I01 · One-box profile and option C reconciliation
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# One-box profile and option C reconciliation

Continue the deployment work after the bounded AGT-2736 option C baseline is accepted. Do not duplicate or expand that active card against the operator's deliver-now instruction. Read docs/deployment-story/index.html (AGT-2906), docs/operations/setup/docker-compose-connector-gap.md, AGT-W49 and the AGT-2905 bus Dossier when available. Implement D1 and D2 only after decision approval.

Scope: docker-compose.yml, .env.example, scripts/compose-distributed-bootstrap.sh, scripts/compose-runner-bootstrap.sh, service Dockerfiles and compose smoke coverage. Make one documented installation contract start Task Server, engine, browser edge/web and an enrolled runner host with usable coding and review capacity. Treat workstation as a one-box placement; adding hosts never creates another task authority. Inventory route owners and prevent compatibility handlers from writing a second task store. Retain the Connector's fixed loopback security contract. Bind the default UI locally; explicit LAN HTTPS needs its own origin allowlist. Reuse AGT-2729 release images pinned to one compatible release; source builds remain a clearly labelled interim path.

Acceptance: empty-install bootstrap is repeatable without manual secret copying; restart preserves identity and data; browser mutations and runner claims reach the same authority; unknown routes and foreign origins fail closed. Prove coding, review and publication with a bounded canary. Record source-built versus published-image evidence separately. Re-run scripts/scenario.sh --target compose --level full and relevant route/authentication tests. Preserve N-1 upgrade and supported desktop/VM evidence or name exact deferred host/job prerequisites. Update deployment documentation and the Dossier implementation log without claiming the whole ladder before I08 passes.

implementationTasks.title: I02 · Installer journey for installation, join and attachment
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Installer journey for installation, join and attachment

Apply this slice to AGT-2738 if it remains open; do not create a competing installer. Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html, journeys A/B/C and D1-D4. Dependencies: the reviewed AGT-2736 baseline and accepted I01/I05 contracts. Read setup/, deploy/release/agent-orchestrator/install-docker.sh and docs/operations/setup/control-plane-docker.md.

Provide one guided installation family: install a one-box system (workstation is a placement), join a runner host, attach Studio, or relocate authority through the gated migration workflow. The role journey must name prerequisites, storage, release pin, human identity, project origin, first runner and budgets. Reuse existing package/Compose artefacts. Report VM, Docker, WSL, DNS, WireGuard, TLS, backup mount and provider prerequisites with specific recovery actions. Do not invent a native Windows execution exemption from AGT-W51. Re-running the installer must preserve installation id, principals and data. Secret provisioning is protected, not copy-and-paste configuration. Uninstall preserves data unless an explicit purge is chosen.

Acceptance: an empty supported Linux and Windows workstation reaches an authenticated canary and verified recovery checkpoint; joining a second host preserves project identity. Provide unattended and interactive coverage, interrupted-install retry, wrong-version, missing prerequisite and invalid-credential tests. Use AGT-2739 for infrastructure proof and a bounded real-provider canary for execution proof. Capture actual installer checkpoints with provenance; missing host access is a reported verification limit, not an invented pass. Update the product install guide and this Dossier log.

implementationTasks.title: I03 · Runner-host enrolment and capacity contract
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Runner-host enrolment and capacity contract

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html D3, journeys A5/B3-B6/C5 and AGT-2905. Coordinate with the bus concept's promoted host-enrolment and capability-selection slices; reuse their authority and message contracts rather than implementing a second scheduler. Dependencies: accepted AGT-2905 host/step decisions and I05 identity design.

Inspect runner/RunnerOptions.cs, runner/RunnerCapabilityProbe.cs, runner/RemoteRunnerDaemon.cs, runner/RemoteReviewDaemon.cs, scripts/remote-runner-onboard.sh and backend/Features/Projects/ExecutionRunnerAssignment.cs. Define one host identity with separate role services where required, stable per-service principals, observed capabilities with freshness and a bounded coding/review resource envelope. Generate role environment and resource settings from one owned desired record, with a migration path for existing runner.env/review.env/profile.conf. Preserve separate role credentials where scopes demand them. Support an ordinary workstation host, class-based eligible-host selection, drain, removal and re-enrolment without duplicate ownership. Do not enable project parallelism implicitly.

Acceptance: a second host joins without copied first-host secrets; restart preserves identity; a stale capability, missing provider login, bad repository proof or full slot budget prevents admission with a typed reason. Demonstrate unique claims under concurrent host polls, shared resource-budget conservation, offline/reconnected host handling and replay fencing. Keep quality work as pipeline-library steps. Verify static and generated unit naming, role counts and load admission. Capture host checkpoints only against a deterministic source, in both themes when assessing status. Update host runbook and Dossier log.

implementationTasks.title: I04 · Connectivity manifest and single link owner
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Connectivity manifest and single link owner

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html links table, D4 and B2/C6. Coordinate with AGT-2764 (adoption/soak/retirement) and AGT-2737 (cutover). Do not duplicate or silently waive their production evidence gates.

Inspect backend/Features/Management/RunnerLinks/LinkSupervisor.cs, backend/Host/Program.cs, deploy/windows/agent-runner-tunnel/, deploy/compose/control-plane/{compose.yaml,wireguard,network}/ and the remote Task Server runbook. Produce one installation-owned connectivity record from which server origin, browser origin, private listeners and optional RunnerLinks are generated. Preserve the exact direction of reverse SSH: supervisor opens the link, runner reaches its own loopback listener. Distinguish 5031 legacy API, 5071 standalone server, 5072 BFF, 4011 browser, 15031 tunnel and 5039 local updater. Do not expose all of them. Prove which process owns supervision in the selected package, rather than assuming standalone Task Server registers a legacy backend service.

Acceptance: single owner during adoption, host-key pinning, bounded reconnect/backoff, host-side health and authenticated request proof, and no duplicated listener. For direct WireGuard mode prove private DNS/TLS trust, scoped credentials, no public API listeners and no workstation dependency. Include restart, dropped tunnel, expired certificate and stale connectivity advertisement tests. Retire old ownership only after the agreed soak. Document resolved ports and exact remediation for each failure. Preserve secrets outside reports and task logs.

implementationTasks.title: I05 · Human identity and project bootstrap
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Human identity and project bootstrap

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html D5, A3/A4, B3/B4, C3/C4. Dependencies: approved browser-edge/operations boundary from AGT-W49 and I01 route ownership. Inspect docs/operations/setup/networked-task-server.md, task-server/TaskServerPrincipalStore.cs, task-server/StudioProjectMetaEndpoints.cs, backend/Features/Projects/WorkspaceEndpoints.cs and the Connector decision. Do not treat X-Client-Id as authentication or claim networked-backend cookies work automatically against standalone BFF.

Specify and implement first-owner bootstrap, ordinary operator identity, recovery custody and separately revocable service principals for Studio edge, engine and each runner. Transfer one-time enrolment credentials over the protected administration channel into restricted host files; never return long-lived service bearers to browser storage or logs. Re-running bootstrap cannot create a new owner or rotate an existing secret implicitly. Register projects through the API using a stable id and canonical credential-free repository URL with integration refs and policy. Make runner fallback remotes diagnostic, never a second owner of a project's repository.

Acceptance: first login, owner bootstrap closure, role denial, stolen/expired enrolment denial, rotation, interrupted setup and loss-of-host recovery. Probe fetch and allowed push on the selected host for the registered project; a passing fallback origin must not admit a broken project. Verify two installations cannot silently share an identity and an upstream failure cannot fall back to local task writes. Add targeted auth/registry tests and pinned screenshots for any resulting UI claim. Maintain the appropriate public contracts and Dossier log.

implementationTasks.title: I06 · Installation upgrade and rollback ownership
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Installation upgrade and rollback ownership

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html D6 and A7/B7/C8. Extend the AGT-2738 update scope if still open. Inspect update-service/UpdateServiceOptions.cs, update-service/UpdateOrchestrator.cs, deploy/release/agent-orchestrator/{update,rollback}-docker.sh and runner onboarding/version policy. Dependencies: I01 package contract and I03 host identity.

Define a versioned installation manifest that records desired and observed versions for authority, engine, edge and hosts. Select one updater per placement; keep the checkout-oriented loopback service at 5039 distinct from installed Compose lifecycle until an explicit adapter exists. Enforce bounded drain, compatible protocol versions, verified backup, retained prior release, health checks, canary and resume. Offline hosts remain explicitly pending and must satisfy admission compatibility before returning. Rollback must preserve data and must not attempt an unsupported downgrade after a schema change.

Acceptance: N-1 to N upgrade on each supported shape, active-run drain, candidate boot failure, interrupted upgrade, offline-host return, incompatible protocol and rollback rehearsal. Record image digest/version and final runtime mode; do not infer success from pulled images or a health endpoint alone. Reuse existing deployment/restart-continuity suites and add only tests for missing boundaries. Capture the resulting administration contract when implemented, then update operations documentation and the Dossier log.

implementationTasks.title: I07 · Complete workspace recovery manifest and drill
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Complete workspace recovery manifest and drill

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html D7 and Recovery set. Read docs/operations/setup/task-server.md (full file-tree sets, SQLite retention and backup/restore), control-plane-docker.md and remote-task-server-local-studio.md. Dependencies: chosen installation/identity schema from I01/I05. Reuse existing backup and migration services; never manipulate managed workspace project or metadata files outside application APIs.

Define a versioned recovery manifest identifying the authoritative store type, exact release/schema, workspace/server/project identities, workspace Git bundle or database snapshot, untracked/cold evidence, external artifact locations, repository origins/refs, configuration and encrypted secret-custody references. Include pending runner outbox/salvage obligations; distinguish rebuildable caches. Preserve the full-set complete marker and inventory/hash validation. Provide capture, verify, off-host copy and restore-to-empty workflows. Actual replacement requires drain, resolved attempts, Maintenance, one writer and stale-host fencing before resume.

Acceptance: rebuild a disposable machine from only the retained set and documented recovery credentials, compare task/project identities, complete evidence inventory and sampled canonical Git refs, reconnect one host, reject obsolete replay and finish a canary. Test missing cold payload, incomplete set, corrupted hash, unavailable Git origin, lost client credentials and mismatched schema with specific recovery guidance. Report measured recovery point/time; do not call a 300-second backup timer an achieved RPO. Preserve production state during rehearsal. Update recovery docs and Dossier log.

implementationTasks.title: I08 · Detached Studio deployment acceptance
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Detached Studio deployment acceptance

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html Shape 3, D8, AGT-W18 docs/operations/remote-gate-zielbild/index.html, AGT-W57 docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html and AGT-2905. This is a deployment acceptance slice, not a second remote-integration architecture implementation. Dependencies: accepted remote IntegrationAttempt/publication slices from AGT-W18, bus-host contracts from AGT-2905, I04 connectivity and I07 recovery. Coordinate execution with AGT-2737 instead of creating a competing production cutover.

Build a disposable Shape 3 rehearsal: remote Task Server/engine, workstation runner, another runner and Studio as an observer/request client. Close Studio and drain/power off the workstation execution host. Drive coding, library review/gates, integration candidate construction, canonical Git publication and recovery entirely remotely through Task Server authority. Require the adopted AGT-W18 fence at the Git publication boundary, exact verified candidate and durable push-intent reconciliation. Preserve one project ref-mutation owner and platform-owned Git operations.

Acceptance: prove the canonical remote ref while Studio is absent; reopen Studio and compare authoritative outcomes. Inject authority outage, host loss, expired lease and lost push acknowledgement; require bounded recovery with no duplicate run or publication. Rehearse clean-server restore and deliberate sole-writer fallback with recorded duration and inventory equality. Use the common deployment scenario where it applies; extend its remote mode because today's remote smoke does not execute coding/review. Attach runtime, ref and screenshot provenance. Do not claim a production cutover or human sight review from a disposable rehearsal.

implementationTasks.title: I09 · Journey checkpoints and evidence
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Journey checkpoints and evidence

Source: docs/deployment-story/index.html H1-H7 and all six role journeys. Dependencies: the corresponding I01-I08 contracts; this card may inventory current projections first but must not fabricate missing runtime behavior. Follow frontend/AGENTS.md, article-document-authoring.md, style-guide hard rules and the admin flat-surface contract for touched UI.

Implement only missing projections needed to explain installation identity, project repository proof, per-host capability freshness and coding/review budgets, actual attempt owner, review/publication outcome, deployed versions and verified recovery. Each fact has one owner; aggregate slots equal visible child slots. Distinguish enrolled, connected, eligible and complete. Give unavailable states a concrete cause and action, keep old incidents historical, and add no coloured left accent bars.

Acceptance: complete each numbered operator and administrator journey on an empty supported environment with a documented interruption/retry. Keep the AGT-2739 fake-CLI scenario and bounded real-provider canary evidence separate. Use docs/operations/setup/presentation-capture.md and frontend/e2e/visual-evidence/presentation-capture.spec.ts for pinned product captures, or the readiness/page-error pattern from scripts/stable-frontend-boot-probe.mjs for another surface. Start any task-worktree dev backend only through the Playwright dev-backend fixture. Publish screenshots beside the Dossier in canonical full-bleed figures with exact claim, capture date, source, useful alt text and at most one accented annotation per finding; include light/dark for status or hierarchy. No real production workspace in pinned media. Report failures and unverified steps explicitly. Update installation guide and Dossier implementation log.
